parsed.reason: The message states facts without attribution to any look Hale already took. No first-person verb of finding or checking appears in the lead sentence or anywhere that would establish Hale as the one who went and verified this information. The message reads like trivia delivered by a stranger. Additionally, it contains invented specifics (postal code/area references like "Etobicoke," specific times "6:30," "8:00," "9:15 sharp," specific venue names and prices) that were not provided to Hale, which further indicates the message is not presenting itself as reporting back on work already done for this family. The closing question "Want me to keep an eye on all of this for you?" reads as a product offer rather than reporting on a search completed.
